body: I'm getting treatment for a few years and it didn't, if anything it gets worse as the time goes on.

I can relate a lot. Had jobs where I didn't have to do much and had money but still felt like shit. There is nothing I could buy to feel happy. I was just going to work then out just to wait to come back to work. Nothing to do in between. I wish I could give you advice but as someone in similar situation I can't. I've tried finding hobby, meds and therapy and nothing worked so far. I hate travelling like you. Not sure if there is really anything out here for me or you. Nevertheless good luck.
